page.layout: One page of text, one column of verse-like lines set full width, with a running head at the top, the page number at the top right, a gathering signature and catchword at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Mantuanus in 8 Fastorum libro, Satanicis his tunc nugis illusus, sic refert:

Solicitus demum pro posteritate, penates Venit in Aufonios. Penetrauit limina summi Alta sacerdotis: qui postquam somnia uidit Admiranda, uirum blandas admisit in ulnas, Et genus illius durare in secula iussit.

Viderat in somnis Laterani ingentia templi Tecta ruinosum caput inclinare, uirumq; Suppofuisse humero, & fustinuisse ruinam. Taliter admonitus pastor, succurrere sibi Posse hominem fidei rebus, regnoq; labanti: Annuit, & uentis impleuit uela secundis.

Pro Franciscanis etiam, ut & illi de suis fictionibus gloriantur, idem Mantuanus, magnae tunc me-retricis poculo inebriatus, in 1o Fastorum libro, fabulosum hoc portentum in sui Francisci gratia adducit:

Umber erat, coluit Tuscae montana Lauernae, Quae firum[?] tutelae fuit: pannosus, & ultro Factum inops, missio sua sub uestigia fastu. Mortales longe ante alios mitemq; humilemq; Se exhibuit, Christi ante oculos patientis imago Semper erat. Plagas & uerbera mente ferebat: Et quas mente tulit, Deus apparere figuras Illius in membris uoluit. Nam ulnere pectus, Vulnere signauit palmas, & ulnere plantas.

page.notes: The line break "fabu-/losum" has no printed hyphen; written whole. "Quae firum tutelae" is doubtful where the letters overlap in the scan. "Franciscigratia" is read as "Francisci gratia". The catchword "Huius" is partly obscured at its final letter but reads as shown. Long s has been normalised to s throughout.
